summary: Exited at -38.5pts when the mean-reversion thesis broke down: through frames 0-4 negative 1m lambda_21 (t=-3 to -4) correctly predicted repeated snap-backs toward breakeven despite growing adverse excursions (-14, -12, -22). At frame 5 both HA and PROPP fires flipped to against-position simultaneously, 15s lambda_21 flipped hard positive (t=+5.67, signaling trend persistence rather than reversion), volatility expanded sharply, and price hit a fresh uncontested extreme (0% giveback) nearly double the prior low. Next time I'd watch for this exact combination -- multiple independent against-fires aligning with a fast-TF lambda sign-flip plus zero giveback at a new extreme -- as the specific signature that a chop/reversion regime has transitioned into a real adverse trend, rather than waiting for price to simply keep making new lows.
